name: @npm_xiyuan/vision-foundation-mcp
description: Vision understanding MCP service powered by local SmolVLM / SmolVLM2 / MiniCPM-V via llama.cpp

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && for d in src/skills/*/; do cp -r $d dist/skills/$(basename $d); done
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build
scripts.test: vitest run --fileParallelism=false tests/runtime-detector.test.ts tests/m4-e2e.test.ts tests/gguf-provider.test.ts tests/mcp-integration.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --fileParallelism=false tests/provider-router.test.ts tests/planner-active-provider.test.ts tests/model-manager.test.ts tests/minicpm-provider.test.ts tests/smolvlm2-provider.test.ts tests/ppu-paddle-ocr-provider.test.ts tests/annotation-detector.test.ts tests/key-content-extractor.test.ts tests/provider-capabilities.test.ts tests/vision-analyze-routing.test.ts tests/vision-error-classification.test.ts tests/config.test.ts tests/options-propagation.test.ts tests/runtime-detector.test.ts tests/classify-skill.test.ts tests/skill-prompt-detail.test.ts tests/compose-result-heuristic.test.ts tests/llama-server-resolver.test.ts tests/llama-server-process-registry.test.ts tests/llama-server-stop.test.ts
scripts.test:slow: vitest run --fileParallelism=false tests/m1-skeleton.test.ts tests/m1.5-real-inference.test.ts tests/m2-core-engine.test.ts tests/minicpm-inference.test.ts tests/smolvlm2-inference.test.ts
